inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Detect usage of User Delegation Key to download/read Blob

properties.description: A User Delegation SAS functions similar to a SAS but is protected with Microsoft Entra ID credentials rather than the storage account key. The creation of a User Delegation SAS is tracked as a corresponding "GetUserDelegationKey" log entry in StorageBlobLogs table.
properties.displayName: [NopalCyber] Detect usage of User Delegation Key to download/read Blob
properties.query:
StorageBlobLogs 
| where AuthenticationType has "DelegationSas" 
| where OperationName has "GetBlob" 
| where StatusText in~ ("Success", "AnonymousSuccess", "SASSuccess") 
| project
    Type,
    TimeGenerated,
    OperationName,
    AccountName,
    UserAgentHeader,
    ObjectKey,
    AuthenticationType,
    StatusCode,
    CallerIpAddress,
    Uri
